shawn desman.bio: Mississauga-born singer, songwriter and dancer Shawn Desman became a major Canadian R&B and pop figure through dance-focused singles and high-energy performance.

shawn hook.bio: British Columbia singer-songwriter Shawn Hook makes piano-led pop, with a career spanning recording, television composition and international touring.

shawnee kish.bio: Two-Spirit Mohawk singer-songwriter Shawnee Kish is an award-winning Canadian artist known for powerhouse vocals and identity-rooted songwriting.

shay lia.bio: Montréal-based singer-songwriter Shay Lia pairs soulful vocals with danceable alternative R&B and has frequently collaborated with Kaytranada.

storry.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter and visual artist STORRY is a multidisciplinary Canadian performer whose independent work combines R&B and soul with conceptual storytelling.

stereos.bio: Edmonton pop-rock band Stereos broke nationally after appearing on MuchMusic's disBAND, pairing big pop hooks with electronic and hip-hop-influenced production.

rheostatics.bio: Toronto art-rock band Rheostatics has spent decades pushing Canadian rock in experimental directions while drawing deeply on the country's culture and landscape.

sofia camara.bio: Portuguese-Canadian singer-songwriter Sofia Camara, raised in Toronto, writes confessional pop and R&B centred on guitar and voice.

tia wood.bio: Saddle Lake Cree Nation singer-songwriter Tia Wood is a Plains Cree and Coast Salish Canadian artist whose soulful pop and R&B connects contemporary songwriting with the musical traditions of her community.

valaire.bio: Montréal group VALAIRE makes groove-heavy electronic music shaped by jazz, funk and hip-hop, evolving from the band's earlier Misteur Valaire name.

walk off the earth.bio: Burlington, Ontario band Walk Off the Earth is known for inventive multi-instrumental arrangements, viral performance videos and a broad international touring career.
